verdict.rationale: An official AWS Pricing Calculator exists at calculator.aws, which covers the 'estimate a stack before signing' half of the story, but the evidence is only a title-level mention with no detail on how it works. The pack contains no evidence of public per-service pricing pages; the free-tier credit pages describe promotions, not rate cards. Community complaints about pricing 'opaqueness' are general sentiment and do not contradict that pricing is published. Missing for 10: evidence of public per-service pricing pages, documentation of calculator depth (multi-service stack estimates, exportable estimates), independent or hands-on corroboration.
